sources.title: migri.fi
highlights: To be allowed to move to Finland for longer than 90 days, you need a residence permit
In contrast, if you apply for a residence permit on some other grounds while in Finland, the decision will usually be negative

sources.title: migri.fi
highlights: Apply for a residence permit with this application if you are coming to Finland to work for a Finnish employer or other employer operating in Finland
If you cannot use Enter Finland, fill in a paper application
Show the passport when you visit a service point to prove your identity
The passport photo must be no more than 6 months old
This document is not needed if you apply for an extended permit
After you have submitted your application in Enter Finland, your employer must add your terms of employment and other required documents to your application using Enter Finland for Employers
